Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call recap & mutual action plan for QuickPilot

Hi Elena — thanks for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our 45-minute discovery so we have alignment and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please reply with any adjustments.

Top pain points you confirmed
- Latency spikes on inference during peak appointment volumes (200–300 concurrent requests) causing degraded UX.
- Variable cost per request due to inconsistent batching and parallel workloads across services.
- Security/compliance: need isolation for PHI-adjacent payloads and audit logs for model access.

Goals you shared
1) Reduce tail latency for triage assistant to sub-500ms 95th percentile for 99% of requests in pilot.
2) Demonstrate 30–40% reduction in tokens billed per conversation using Redwood caching/batching within pilot scope.
3) Validate end-to-end security controls for SOC2 readiness and evidence for procurement.

Suggested Mutual Action Plan (high level) — target pilot window: 6 weeks
- Week 0 (this week): MAP sign-off + procurement contacts + legal kickoff.
- Week 1: Environment provisioning (sandbox dedicated instance) + baseline latency/cost telemetry.
- Week 2–4: Pilot run with two flows (triage assistant, discharge summary) + weekly checkpoints.
- Week 5: Quality & cost review; decision meeting with stakeholders.
- Week 6: Recommendation and next steps (Dedicated capacity or hosted scale).

Owners / stakeholders (proposed)
- Halcyon: Elena Santos (Product), Ari Malik (Procurement), procurement@halcyonhealth.com
- Redwood: Markus Klein (AE), Ben Carter (Solutions), Laura Bennett (SRE lead)

Open asks from Redwood
1) Procurement contact details & preferred PO process (we'll send SOW + pricing).
2) High-level data flow diagram for the two flows (to confirm isolation requirements).
3) A short list of 3 evaluation prompts/traffic profile to run baseline tests.

Attachments: QuickPilot_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), QuickPilot_SOW_scope.pdf (SOW draft)

Next step: If this looks good, can you confirm "accept MAP v1" and loop in procurement? Happy to set a 30-min kickoff with Ben and Laura later this week.

Thanks — Markus

1) Procurement: Ari Malik (cc'd) is our procurement lead — Ari, we typically run on a 30-day net payment and prefer a short SOW + PO. Please advise if Redwood needs an MSA first.
2) Timeline: we prefer a 7-week pilot so we have an extra buffer for IT review. Week 2 may need an extra day for sandbox networking.
3) Security docs: we'll send a short security questionnaire tonight (we use a vendor questionnaire template). Laura — can you confirm how much detail you need in the data flow vs. an architecture diagram?

We're happy to proceed if Redwood can:
- Share a redlined SOW we can circulate to legal.
- Provide the baseline telemetry script or a short list of required metrics so our infra can start collecting.

Confirming acceptance of MAP v1 subject to the two timeline tweaks above.
